purpose: Exercise internal stock fulfilment through accepted receipt and stock posting.
preconditions: An employee has a draft indent with required item details.
Sufficient allocable departmental or central stock is available.
An authorized receiving actor can inspect delivery.
action_or_input: Submit the indent; have the Department Admin reserve stock, approve internal issue, and record picking and dispatch; record an accepted full receipt; have the employee confirm receipt.
expected_result: The indent progresses through Submitted, Stock Reserved, Internal Issue Approved, Dispatched / Ready for Receipt, GRN Accepted, and Receipt Confirmed / Stock Posted. The accepted receipt is posted after confirmation with no unresolved discrepancy.

source_id: BW-PSM-01 transition 5; BW-PSM-02 transitions 1–5; BW-PSM-04 transitions 1–6
purpose: Exercise the insufficient-stock external procurement standard path, direct method, and partial accepted receipt.
preconditions: An employee has a draft indent with required item details.
Insufficient allocable stock is available.
Configured policy does not require final Director / Registrar review and selects direct procurement.
The vendor is verified and required approvals are complete.
The delivery supports an accepted partial receipt.
action_or_input: Submit the indent; have the Department Admin check stock and approve further processing; have the Department Head recommend onward; have the Procurement & Stores Admin select direct procurement, issue a PO, and record delivery. Inspect and record a partial accepted GRN, confirm delivery, verify an invoice that matches the eligible amount, and process payment.
expected_result: The indent reaches External Procurement Required, Department Reviewed, Department Head Recommended, and Procurement Authorized / Method Selected. The PO is issued only after approvals and vendor verification. Delivery progresses through Delivered, GRN Accepted, Receipt Confirmed, Invoice Verified, and Paid / Partially Paid for the eligible amount.

purpose: Exercise the final authority approval path followed by tender procurement to payment.
preconditions: An employee has a draft indent with required item details.
Insufficient allocable stock is available.
Configured policy requires final Director / Registrar review and selects tender procurement.
A committee-approved tender selection and a verified vendor are available.
action_or_input: Submit the indent; have the Department Admin check stock and approve further processing; have the Department Head recommend onward; have the Procurement & Stores Admin record the recommendation for final authority. Have the Director / Registrar approve; record the committee-approved tender selection; issue the PO and record delivery. Accept the receipt, confirm delivery, verify a matching invoice, and process payment.
expected_result: The indent reaches Awaiting Final Approval and, upon approval, Procurement Authorized / Method Selected. The committee-approved tender selection produces Tender Vendor Selected; the verified vendor and completed approvals permit PO issuance. The flow proceeds through Delivered, GRN Accepted, Receipt Confirmed, Invoice Verified, and Paid / Partially Paid.

source_id: BW-PSM-04 transition 5; BW-PSM-06 transitions 1–5; CW-PSM-02 transitions 2, 4, 5, 8, 9
purpose: Exercise discrepancy reporting, return / adjustment resolution without replacement, and downstream invoice and payment handling.
preconditions: A delivered procurement has a discrepancy identified during inspection.
The discrepancy is resolved by return / adjustment without replacement.
An eligible remaining invoice amount exists after resolution.
action_or_input: Record the discrepancy during inspection; report it and open a discrepancy case; have the Procurement & Stores Admin resolve it through return / adjustment and post adjustments. Verify the remaining invoice and process payment for the eligible amount.
expected_result: The flow progresses through Discrepancy Identified, Discrepancy Case Open, and Case Resolved / Adjustments Posted without a replacement traversal. The invoice becomes Invoice Verified or Closed as applicable; payment reaches Paid / Closed only when an eligible amount exists.

purpose: Exercise exactly one replacement traversal for a discrepancy through payment.
preconditions: A delivered procurement has a discrepancy identified during inspection.
The open discrepancy case is resolved by replacement.
The replacement is delivered and accepted.
action_or_input: Report the discrepancy and open a case; have the Procurement & Stores Admin record replacement. Inspect and accept the replacement, confirm its receipt, verify the invoice / adjustment match, and process payment.
expected_result: The case progresses through Replacement Awaited, Replacement GRN Accepted, Replacement Confirmed, Invoice Verified, and Paid / Partially Paid when an eligible amount exists. Exactly one replacement traversal is recorded.

purpose: Exercise modification of a pending indent in a permissible state and its return to review.
preconditions: An employee has a submitted indent in a permissible modifiable state.
The proposed modification validates.
action_or_input: Modify the pending indent; have the Department Admin complete review and, where required, have the Department Head record a recommendation.
expected_result: A distinct modified version is retained and the indent progresses through Modified / Awaiting Re-review, Department Reviewed, and Department Head Recommended when Department Head review is required.

purpose: Exercise inter-departmental stock transfer through destination receipt and ledger update.
preconditions: A Department Admin can submit a valid transfer request.
Sufficient allocable stock is available at the source department.
action_or_input: Submit the transfer request; have the source Department Admin / Stores process and dispatch it; have the destination Department Admin confirm receipt.
expected_result: The transfer progresses through Transfer Requested and Transfer Dispatched to Transfer Completed / Ledgers Updated, with source and destination stock ledgers updated upon completion.

purpose: Verify that an invoice mismatch is held rather than verified for payment.
preconditions: A delivered procurement has an accepted GRN and confirmed delivery.
The submitted invoice does not match the PO and GRN.
action_or_input: Submit the mismatched invoice for three-way verification, then attempt payment processing.
expected_result: The invoice is placed on hold and payment is not released while the mismatch remains.
